description.en: Specifies whether the startup depends on the disk.

description.zh: 要修改实例的ID，仅支持修改单个。
description.en: The ID of the instance for which you want to modify the configuration. You can specify only one ID.

descriptions.zh:
- 实例状态为启动中（Starting）时，无法重置实例密码。

- 实例状态为运行中（Running）时，无法修改实例密码。

- 重置密码后，您需要在控制台重启实例或者调用RebootInstance接口使更改生效，在实例内部重启将不会生效。
descriptions.en:
- If an instance is in the Starting state, you cannot reset the password of the instance.

- If the instance is in the Running state, you cannot change the password of the instance.

- After resetting the password, you must restart the instance in the ENS console or call the RebootInstance operation to apply the change. The restart operation within the instance does not apply the change.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens modify-instance-boot-configuration --instance-id i-instance0000 --boot-type pxe --boot-set legacy --disk-set on --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens ModifyInstanceBootConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'i-instance0000' --BootSet legacy --BootType pxe --DiskSet on
